## iPhone remote on your HTPC

Canapey keeps using its active private Windows network while that adapter and address remain available. Connecting another adapter should no longer interrupt discovery or a pairing code. The receiver also keeps a Companion session open when the remote sends a NoOp frame. Temporary connection errors clear from iPhone settings once a fresh status arrives.

To pair, connect the PC and iPhone to the same private network. On the PC, open **Settings → iPhone**, enable the remote and select **Pair an iPhone**. In the iPhone's Control Center, open **Apple TV Remote**, select your PC and enter the code shown in Canapey.

## Launcher fixes

- Move Silo on Home and change its server address from the card's actions.
- Keep library search focused when resizing the window. Directional navigation, filter counts and cursor movement over selected text are also corrected.
- Keep app actions pointed at the selected app, require an existing app when saving remote shortcuts, and preserve mute presses during Windows audio refreshes.
- Recover missing settings from the backup and reuse an update check already in progress.

## Install

Use **Settings → Updates → Check for updates** or download the Windows x64 installer below. This experimental release uses signed in-app updates. Automated checks cover Windows network selection, pairing and reconnection. Discovery in Control Center still needs confirmation on a physical iPhone and HTPC.
